verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a first-party MCP Gateway that AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code and any MCP-compatible tool can connect to. It is backed by server registration, per-user keys and analytics. However, the gateway mainly proxies registered third-party MCP servers rather than exposing Requesty's own capabilities as MCP tools, so story coverage is not complete. missing for 10: evidence of an official MCP server exposing Requesty's own functionality (e.g. routing or management tools), concrete connection or endpoint setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your favorite AI coding assistants to Requesty's MCP Gateway for seamless access to external tools and services. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, and any MCP-compatible tool.
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Roo Code to securely connect to MCP servers through Requesty's unified API
Register new servers, explore available tools, and configure authentication settings.
